abstract: Maintains bulk cryogenic replenishment agreements, emergency resupply response logs, and on-site vapor-phase vat volume inventories
system_message:
You are the Cryogenic logistics coordinator (CRYO). Your responsibilities include maintaining bulk cryogenic replenishment agreements, emergency resupply response logs, and on-site vapor-phase vat volume inventories, as well as conducting boil-off mitigation monitoring across candidate repository sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains bulk cryogenic replenishment agreements, emergency resupply response logs, and on-site vapor-phase vat volume inventories（NITRO）
information_points.content:
CRYO-NITRO-VNX：At Otaniemi Deep Geothermal Research Bunker, backup cryogen storage is activated with the on-site bulk emergency liquid nitrogen backup reservoir commissioned for automatic feed. The emergency cryogen replenishment delivery time under contractual emergency dispatch is 240 min, and cryogenic vapor-phase vat capacity totals 160000 vials in commissioned dewars at minus 190 degrees Celsius.
CRYO-NITRO-JIK：At Kallio Underground Rock Cavern Facility, backup cryogen storage is activated with the on-site bulk emergency liquid nitrogen backup reservoir commissioned for automatic feed. The emergency cryogen replenishment delivery time under contractual emergency dispatch is 150 min, and cryogenic vapor-phase vat capacity totals 120000 vials in commissioned dewars at minus 190 degrees Celsius.
CRYO-NITRO-F8O：At Viikki Agricultural Biosafety Vault, backup cryogen storage is activated with the on-site bulk emergency liquid nitrogen backup reservoir commissioned for automatic feed. The emergency cryogen replenishment delivery time under contractual emergency dispatch is 120 min, and cryogenic vapor-phase vat capacity totals 80000 vials in commissioned dewars at minus 190 degrees Celsius.

information_points.title: Boil-off mitigation monitoring（EVAP）
information_points.content:
CRYO-EVAP-ICL：For Kallio Underground Rock Cavern Facility, the daily nitrogen boil-off rate across static vacuum-insulated bulk liquid nitrogen vessels is recorded at 1.2 %/d during a twenty-four-hour quiescent period.
CRYO-EVAP-V37：For Viikki Agricultural Biosafety Vault, the daily nitrogen boil-off rate across static vacuum-insulated bulk liquid nitrogen vessels is recorded at 1.8 %/d during a twenty-four-hour quiescent period.
CRYO-EVAP-DC1：For Otaniemi Deep Geothermal Research Bunker, the daily nitrogen boil-off rate across static vacuum-insulated bulk liquid nitrogen vessels is recorded at 2.5 %/d during a twenty-four-hour quiescent period.
